text:
anya: quick heads up — Datadog PM (maria-dd) asked for a private-preview of our OTLP sample collector + dashboard bundle for Private deployments. want to run a gated demo sprint next Tue/Wed. who can own end-to-end?

jason: I can take lead on the integration checklist. need to confirm airgap constraints and packaging format.

priya: +1 on lead. marketplace wants: dashboard templates, sample traces, install runbook, and a tiny sample app that emits OTLP. also need a one-pager for SI handoff.

cheng: airgapped customers won't have internet egress — collector needs to support file/export mode and a local agent. prototype config snippet i tested:

```yaml
receivers: [otlp]
exporters: [file]
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [file]
```

cheng: run command to simulate: `docker run --rm -p 4317:4317 otel/opentelemetry-collector:latest --config=/etc/collector/config.yaml`

maria-dd: thanks, team. Datadog side can run quick smoke with our private demo account. priority: dashboard tiles (latency, tail-sampling rate, model-id tag), and an example trace that links to tokenized inference spans.

anya: are we including tracing span naming conventions? priya — can you draft the spec for span names + tags so partners have deterministic dashboards?

priya: yes. i'll drop a short doc today with naming + tag keys: `redwood.model_id`, `redwood.request_type`, `redwood.latency_ms`. also include sampling guidance (1% baseline, 100% on error).

jason: timeline proposal: sprint kickoff Mon, package + dashboard templates Tue, partner smoke Wed. owners: jason (integration), priya (docs + dashboards), cheng (collector airgap tests).

obs-bot: CI: collector-build #482 succeeded in 6m 12s — artifacts available at https://ci.redwood.internal/artifacts/482

cheng: noted a gotcha — our default exporter truncates long attrs. need to ensure model_id allows 128 chars. i'll add config and run a quick test.

maria-dd: perfect. if you can get a draft dashboard bundle before Tue AM, i'll schedule the preview with our SRE advocate.

anya: ok locked. i'll schedule 30m sync for Mon 10am PT and add agenda (what success looks like + demo checklist). tagging owners: @jason @priya @cheng :thumbsup:

jason: got it, i'll prepare the install runbook + sample app repo link.

priya: will post naming doc in this thread when ready.

cheng: i'll run airgap tests tonight and post results.

anya: thanks everyone — moving to action items.
